# Repository Instructions

## Project Status

This repository is currently an intentionally minimal scaffold for pulse-hub, an all-in-one social platform combining feeds, rooms, and messaging. No application framework, package manager, build command, or test runner has been selected yet.

## Contribution Guidelines

- Preserve the existing minimal structure until a concrete feature establishes the required stack.
- Keep changes focused on the requested behavior and avoid introducing dependencies without a clear need.
- Update `README.md` when setup, usage, or project decisions become user-facing.
- Add focused tests when implementing executable behavior.
- Do not remove or rename the existing `edit me!` file without an explicit request.
